_note: The plan, beat by beat: Spliced's Build view pairs it with every render. Beat id = its key in cues.json scenes. Statuses: todo, wip, review, changes, approved.
title: Spliced: how it works
message: Spliced turns the films we love into named, reusable moves, and builds new films from them.

beats.title: Open: a caret
beats.on_screen: Ink stage. A volt caret blinks (soft fades, ~1s cycle); two lines type in Anybody wide uppercase, one keystroke at a time, then blur out.
beats.copy: Films you love. / Frame by frame.
beats.sound: Deep techno score, UI sounds on the cuts

beats.title: Paste a link
beats.on_screen: Spliced's real Add references sheet whips in from the right (scale, tilt, blur) and settles under the headline. A link is pasted (a made-up film, drawn in code for this example), focus ring in volt, the cursor presses Add, a job row opens: Download done, Analyse done, Break down running with the Spliced loader (the blocks sink and rise).
beats.sound: Deep techno score, UI sounds on the cuts

beats.title: Cut into scenes
beats.on_screen: The film as one strip of 15 frames, grey and dim. A volt playhead runs across it at play speed: every frame it passes takes its colour, every cut it passes opens a gap and gets its scene id. Then the six segments become six scene cards in a row, with timecode and title under each.
beats.sound: Deep techno score, UI sounds on the cuts

beats.title: Name every move
beats.on_screen: The first card carries to the centre and grows (shared element); the others blur away. Its ID and in/out times appear. A tag chip spins through the taxonomy like a slot reel and lands on blur-in, which fills; its other tags and the rating follow.
beats.sound: Deep techno score, UI sounds on the cuts

beats.title: Find it
beats.on_screen: The app window rises in on the Library (rebuilt from the real view). The cursor clicks Search and types blur-in; the grid re-sorts to the matching scenes while the rest drop away; the first card is picked (volt ring and tint). Slow push-in.
beats.sound: Deep techno score, UI sounds on the cuts

beats.title: Board it
beats.on_screen: Blur through to the Boards view of this very board. Four scene cards drop into a loose pile, then snap into the beat rows; names, scenes and seconds fill in and the beat count climbs. The headline swaps to its second line as beat 3's on-screen line is typed.
beats.copy: Borrow the move. / Write the script.
beats.sound: Deep techno score, UI sounds on the cuts

beats.title: With Claude
beats.on_screen: The board scrolls down. Claude adds two beats: rows grow in with the app's amber live flash, toast 'Claude: added Find it and Board it'. Then beat 4's copy is tightened, flash and second toast.
beats.sound: Deep techno score, UI sounds on the cuts

beats.title: Build view
beats.on_screen: Blur through to the Build view: the render (this film's own end card, playing live) beside its reference (the end card of the made-up film), the beat bar with beat 9 selected and the volt playhead moving. The cursor clicks the render: a note pin drops on the bar and a note is typed: 'Hold the mark a beat longer.'
beats.sound: Deep techno score, UI sounds on the cuts

beats.title: End card
beats.on_screen: Ink stage. The four blocks of the mark rise one after another, lowest first (the brand's build-in, on ease-sink); the mark slides left as the outlined wordmark wipes in; the tagline sharpens in word by word; the blocks sink and rise once.
beats.copy: Spliced / Study it. Name it. Make it.
beats.sound: Deep techno score, UI sounds on the cuts
